newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentina to meet May deficit target -- Guidotti.
newsitem.headline: Argentina to meet May deficit target -- Guidotti.

text.p: Argentina should meet its budget deficit target for May, agreed with the International Monetary Fund, Finance Secretary Pablo Guidotti said Friday.
"We still do not have the number, but the projections we have, have us meeting the target," Guidotti told reporters.
The May target has not been disclosed.

Argentina's stand-by accord with the IMF sets a 1997 deficit target of $3 billion. The country met the first-quarter target with a deficit of $1.04 billion. The second-quarter deficit target is $360 million.
